scope_geometry_screen.role: review prioritization only; NOT semantic scope truth or difficulty definition
scope_geometry_screen.missing: full N remains denominator; invalid records reported with lower and upper possible flagged fractions

scope_review: Inspect photo plus all valid individual footprints and selected/original GT; distinguish local coordinate error/detail from extent/stop-boundary difference; unresolved -> manual queue. Never substitute majority for GT.
difficulty: N and H objectively computed; visual visibility assessed independently by subagent without using worker errors/curves. N<=6 with no/limited occlusion and clear target may be simple; special scenes and uncertain reference separate. Preserve original and visual-assisted judgments.
freeze_boundary: No source GT, annotations, operational eligibility, fusion or old scores changed.
